search_text: published ZDI-26-480 ZDI-CAN-30036 OSNEXUS QuantaStor Missing Authentication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2026-07-29 CVE-2026-18265 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-18265 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['OSNEXUS'] ['QuantaStor'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of OSNEXUS QuantaStor. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of Kapacitor. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. title: OSNEXUS QuantaStor Missing Authentication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of OSNEXUS QuantaStor. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of Kapacitor. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
